name: Flexible Funding Assistance
description: Financial assistance for clients in emergency housing to address immediate wellbeing needs, subject to income, asset, and residential criteria, governed by the Flexible Funding Programme.

attributes.summary: Financial assistance for clients in emergency housing to address immediate wellbeing needs, subject to income, asset, and residential criteria, governed by the Flexible Funding Programme.
attributes.eligibility: Client must qualify for and be staying in emergency housing or in other emergency accommodation. Subject to income limits, cash asset limits, residential criteria, and requirement of an immediate need.
attributes.payment_details: Payments are governed by the Flexible Funding Programme. Dependent child provisions and payment discretion apply.
attributes.obligations: Client must meet income and asset limits, residential criteria, and demonstrate immediate need. Non-compliance with benefit sanctions or warrant situations may result in non-payment.
attributes.stand_down: Benefit sanctioned, reduced, or suspended; Client on non-entitlement period for emergency housing; Warrant for the client's arrest; Client dies while in emergency housing; Payment not used as intended.
attributes.income_test: Income limits apply to determine eligibility for assistance.
